upgrades.name: Larger Potions
upgrades.description: Potions splash over more Bloons in a larger area.

upgrades.name: Acidic Mixture Dip
upgrades.description: Throws a helpful potion at nearby Monkeys that allows them to pop Lead Bloons and do extra damage to Ceramic and MOAB-class Bloons. Wears off after several attacks.

upgrades.name: Berserker Brew
upgrades.description: Throws special brew to a nearby Monkey giving it increased damage, range, and attack speed briefly. Multiple Monkeys can be buffed at once.

upgrades.name: Stronger Stimulant
upgrades.description: Extra strong berserker brew has even more powerful effect on the target. Lasts even longer.

upgrades.name: Permanent Brew
upgrades.description: Berserker brew becomes PERMANENT on Monkeys who drink it.

upgrades.name: Stronger Acid
upgrades.description: Acid potions dissolve Bloons faster.

upgrades.name: Perishing Potions
upgrades.description: Attack potions deal more damage to MOAB-class Bloons and strip Fortified off smaller Bloons. Buff potions last longer.

upgrades.name: Unstable Concoction
upgrades.description: Coats MOAB-Class in an explosive substance that causes a large explosion when they are popped.

upgrades.name: Transforming Tonic
upgrades.description: Transformation ability: Turns Alchemist into powerful attack Monster for 20 seconds.

upgrades.name: Total Transformation
upgrades.description: Transforms five Monkeys nearby into crazy attack monsters for 20 seconds.

upgrades.name: Faster Throwing
upgrades.description: Throws potions and attacks faster.

upgrades.name: Acid Pool
upgrades.description: Every few attacks spills an acid pool on the track, and if no Bloons are nearby Alchemist can drench nearby track with acid.

upgrades.name: Lead to Gold
upgrades.description: Converts Lead Bloons to GOLD! Special solvents do extra damage to Lead Bloons, destroying them in one shot and generating cash.

upgrades.name: Rubber to Gold
upgrades.description: Converts all Bloons partially into gold, disabling Bloon immunity and getting more cash per pop from affected Bloons.

upgrades.name: Bloon Master Alchemist
upgrades.description: Secret shrink potion converts all affected Bloons to Red Bloons.

upgrades.name: Increased Production
upgrades.description: Grows 2 extra Banana bunches per round.

upgrades.name: Greater Production
upgrades.description: Grows 2 MORE extra Banana bunches per round.

upgrades.name: Banana Plantation
upgrades.description: Grows 16 Banana bunches per round.

upgrades.name: Banana Research Facility
upgrades.description: Produces 5 large Banana crates every round worth $300 each.

upgrades.name: Banana Central
upgrades.description: You want Banana? We have Banana!

upgrades.name: Long Life Bananas
upgrades.description: Bananas last 30 seconds before rotting instead of 15.

upgrades.name: Valuable Bananas
upgrades.description: Bananas are worth 25% more cash per bunch.

upgrades.name: Monkey Bank
upgrades.description: All money generated by this farm is now stored in the bank and earns 15% interest each round.

upgrades.name: IMF Loan
upgrades.description: IMF Loan ability: Gives you $9,000 but you have to pay it back over time.

upgrades.name: Monkey-Nomics
upgrades.description: For when you're too big to fail...

upgrades.name: EZ Collect
upgrades.description: The collect radius of Bananas is larger and uncollected Bananas auto-collect for half value. Monkey Banks will glow when full and ready to collect.

upgrades.name: Banana Salvage
upgrades.description: Uncollected Bananas auto-collect for almost their full amount, and Banks auto-collect when full. Farm sellback rate increased by 10%

upgrades.name: Marketplace
upgrades.description: Generates money each round and adds it to your total. No fuss.

upgrades.name: Central Market
upgrades.description: Earns heaps of money each round and gives Merchantmen +10% income.

upgrades.name: Monkey Wall Street
upgrades.description: Hub of Monkey trades earns colossal income, generates lives each round, and collects income in radius.

upgrades.name: Piranha
upgrades.description: Command a small but feisty little fish to leap from the water at the Bloons.

upgrades.name: Barracuda
upgrades.description: The Barracuda slaps Bloons backwards and pops multiple layers with their razor sharp teeth.

upgrades.name: Great White
upgrades.description: The Great White will crush Bloons, including Lead Bloons in its jaws, dragging them back to the water if needed. At max Beast Power the Great White can drag down MOABs.

upgrades.name: Orca
upgrades.description: The mighty Orca's huge mouth can grab and drag all but the very largest Bloons into the depths. At max Beast Power the Orca can drag down ZOMGs.

upgrades.name: Megalodon
upgrades.description: A truly colossal shark with a taste for Bloon. Requires 3 additional Orca Handlers to control.

upgrades.name: Microraptor
upgrades.description: Command a sharp clawed little dinosaur.

upgrades.name: Adasaurus
upgrades.description: The sharp teeth of the Adasaurus deal high short range damage that can tear through Lead.

upgrades.name: Velociraptor
upgrades.description: Velociraptor viciously slashes and chomps, dealing more damage to stunned Bloons.

upgrades.name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
upgrades.description: The Tyrannosaurus Rex's huge jaw and sharp teeth deal a ton of damage with each bite. T Rex Stomp ability: Stuns up to ZOMG Bloons in a wide area.

upgrades.name: Giganotosaurus
upgrades.description: The biggest and most fierce dinosaur of them all, Giganotosaurus can shred almost any Bloon instantly and with ease. Stomp ability hits the whole map and lasts longer. Requires 3 additional Tyrannosaurus Handlers to control.

upgrades.name: Gyrfalcon
upgrades.description: Command a noble little bird of prey that can grab and move Bloons to the drop-off target. Bloons up-track of the target get scratched.

upgrades.name: Horned Owl
upgrades.description: The Horned Owl is strong enough to grab Ceramic Bloons, and has keen eyes that can detect Camo Bloons.

upgrades.name: Golden Eagle
upgrades.description: The Golden Eagle's huge talons make it an expert at grabbing large numbers of Bloons at once. At max Beast Power the Golden Eagle can grab lowest tiers of MOAB.

upgrades.name: Giant Condor
upgrades.description: The huge talons of the fearsome Giant Condor can pick up smaller MOAB-Class Bloons.

upgrades.name: Pouākai
upgrades.description: The legendary Pouākai: a bird so large that it can pick up, carry off and destroy almost any number of Bloons of almost any size. Requires 3 additional Condor Handlers to control.

upgrades.name: Ballistic Obliteration Missile Bunker
upgrades.description: Cluster explosions, anti-MOAB explosions, Bloon stunning explosions, knockback explosions. BOMB has it all!

upgrades.name: Bigger Bombs
upgrades.description: Shoots larger bombs, they have a larger blast area and more popping power.

upgrades.name: Heavy Bombs
upgrades.description: Heavy duty bombs can smash through 2 layers of Bloon at once and pop more Bloons.

upgrades.name: Really Big Bombs
upgrades.description: Huge bombs deal greater damage in a large area and knock Bloons back along the path.

upgrades.name: Bloon Impact
upgrades.description: Explosions become so violent Bloons are stunned for a short time when they are hit. Range is increased and frags are even more effective.

upgrades.name: Bloon Crush
upgrades.description: Bloon shattering explosions do massive damage and can stun MOAB-Class Bloons.

upgrades.name: Faster Reload
upgrades.description: Reloads faster.

upgrades.name: Missile Launcher
upgrades.description: Exchanges bombs for missiles, which fire faster, fly faster, and increase range.

upgrades.name: MOAB Mauler
upgrades.description: MOAB Maulers do much more damage to MOAB-Class Bloons.

upgrades.name: MOAB Assassin
upgrades.description: Assassinate MOAB Ability: Special missile flies out and does massive damage to MOAB class Bloons. Regular attack range and MOAB-class damage also increased.

upgrades.name: MOAB Eliminator
upgrades.description: Massive damage to MOABs and Assassinate ability deals 6x damage with a short cooldown.

upgrades.name: Extra Range
upgrades.description: Increases attack range.

upgrades.name: Frag Bombs
upgrades.description: Explosions throw out sharp fragments that can pop more Bloons.

upgrades.name: Cluster Bombs
upgrades.description: Throws out secondary bombs instead of sharp fragments every shot.

upgrades.name: Recursive Cluster
upgrades.description: Every second shot the cluster bombs send out more cluster bombs for even more destruction.

upgrades.name: Bomb Blitz
upgrades.description: Deals much more damage and gains the passive Bomb Storm Ability - when lives would be lost, the Bomb Storm automatically triggers, which destroys all but the biggest of Bloons.

upgrades.name: Glaive Dominus
upgrades.description: The Bloons will look upon my Glaives, and they will know fear.

upgrades.name: Improved Rangs
upgrades.description: Can pop up to 8 Bloons per throw.

upgrades.name: Glaives
upgrades.description: Throws glaives instead of boomerangs. Glaives are bigger and faster, hitting more Bloons with each throw.

upgrades.name: Glaive Ricochet
upgrades.description: Glaives will bounce from Bloon to Bloon automatically and aggressively.

upgrades.name: M.O.A.R Glaives
upgrades.description: Multiple Object Advanced Ricochet greatly enhances the already extraordinary powers of the Glaive Ricochet Monkey.

upgrades.name: Glaive Lord
upgrades.description: Glaive Lord surrounds itself in 3 special glaives that shred anything that comes near. Glaive Lord's glaives now rip through MOAB-class Bloons, slowly tearing them apart from the inside.

upgrades.name: Faster Throwing
upgrades.description: Throws boomerangs faster.

upgrades.name: Faster Rangs
upgrades.description: Boomerangs fire and travel faster.

upgrades.name: Bionic Boomerang
upgrades.description: Replaces arm with a strong bionic arm that can throw boomerangs extremely fast and do more damage to MOAB class Bloons.

upgrades.name: Turbo Charge
upgrades.description: Turbo Charge ability: Makes this Monkey attack incredibly fast for 10 seconds.

upgrades.name: Perma Charge
upgrades.description: Perma Charge has permanent super fast attack speed. Ability increases the lethality even more.

upgrades.name: Long Range Rangs
upgrades.description: Can throw boomerangs further than normal.

upgrades.name: Red Hot Rangs
upgrades.description: Boomerangs now pop Frozen and Lead Bloons and do more damage to all.

upgrades.name: Kylie Boomerang
upgrades.description: Throws heavy Kylie boomerangs that follow a straight path instead of curved.

upgrades.name: MOAB Press
upgrades.description: Heavy Kylie boomerang hits MOAB-Class Bloons multiple times per throw and sometimes knocks them back a short way along the path.

upgrades.name: MOAB Domination
upgrades.description: Special knockback kylies trigger more often and do lots of extra damage.

upgrades.name: Apex Plasma Master
upgrades.description: Fill the area with Bloon shredding plasma juggernaut balls, leaving nothing behind...

upgrades.name: Sharp Shots
upgrades.description: Can pop 1 extra Bloon per shot.

upgrades.name: Razor Sharp Shots
upgrades.description: Can pop 2 more Bloons per shot.

upgrades.name: Spike-o-pult
upgrades.description: Converts the Dart Monkey into a slower attacking Spike-o-pult that hurls large spiked balls. Each ball can pop lots of Bloons and rebounds off obstacles.

upgrades.name: Juggernaut
upgrades.description: Hurls a giant spiked ball that pops Lead and excels at crushing Ceramic and Fortified Bloons.

upgrades.name: Ultra-Juggernaut
upgrades.description: Gigantic spiked ball splits twice into 6 Juggernaut balls for even more destructive power against Ceramic, Fortified and Lead Bloons.

upgrades.name: Quick Shots
upgrades.description: Shoots 15% faster.

upgrades.name: Very Quick Shots
upgrades.description: Shoots 33% faster!

upgrades.name: Triple Shot
upgrades.description: Throws 3 darts at a time instead of 1.

upgrades.name: Super Monkey Fan Club
upgrades.description: Super Monkey Fan Club Ability: Converts up to 10 nearby Dart Monkeys including itself into Super Monkeys for 15 seconds. Regular attack speed also increased.

upgrades.name: Plasma Monkey Fan Club
upgrades.description: Elite membership of this club grants the Dart Monkeys even more power!

upgrades.name: Long Range Darts
upgrades.description: Makes the Dart Monkey shoot further than normal.

upgrades.name: Enhanced Eyesight
upgrades.description: Shoots even further and can detect Camo Bloons.

upgrades.name: Crossbow
upgrades.description: Uses a long range Crossbow that can pop 3 layers of Bloon for every hit.

upgrades.name: Sharp Shooter
upgrades.description: Sharp Shooter attacks faster and does powerful Crit shots every few shots that do a lot more damage.

upgrades.name: Crossbow Master
upgrades.description: Crossbow Master shoots really fast and devastates most Bloon types with ease.

upgrades.name: Focused Firing
upgrades.description: Increases accuracy of the Dartling Gun.

upgrades.name: Laser Shock
upgrades.description: Laser tipped shots shock Bloons into popping again 1 second after being struck.

upgrades.name: Laser Cannon
upgrades.description: Rapidly fires much more powerful laser blasts that can pop Frozen Bloons, and deal increased MOAB damage.

upgrades.name: Plasma Accelerator
upgrades.description: Concentrates a powerful beam of energy to a single point.

upgrades.name: Ray of Doom
upgrades.description: Creates a solid line of annihilation. You can erase most Bloons at your leisure.

upgrades.name: Advanced Targeting
upgrades.description: Allows Dartling Gunner to hit Camo Bloons.

upgrades.name: Faster Barrel Spin
upgrades.description: Makes gun fire much faster.

upgrades.name: Hydra Rocket Pods
upgrades.description: Shoots depleted bloontonium missiles that can damage all Bloon types and trigger multiple explosions.

upgrades.name: Rocket Storm
upgrades.description: Rocket Storm ability: Launches a powerful storm of rockets in a wide cone.

upgrades.name: M.A.D
upgrades.description: MOAB Assured Destroyer. Slower firing mega missiles deal extreme damage to MOAB-class Bloons.

upgrades.name: Faster Swivel
upgrades.description: Barrel can swivel much faster.

upgrades.name: Powerful Darts
upgrades.description: Darts move faster, can pop frozen Bloons and can pop 3 Bloons each.

upgrades.name: Buckshot
upgrades.description: Shoots blasts of deadly buckshot instead of darts.

upgrades.name: Bloon Area Denial System
upgrades.description: 4-barreled auto-cannon that can be set to attack automatically.

upgrades.name: Bloon Exclusion Zone
upgrades.description: Upgraded to 6 barrels and massively increased damage. Bloons are excluded from existence.

upgrades.name: Quickdraw
upgrades.description: Attacks faster the further Bloons are from Desperado.

upgrades.name: Standoff
upgrades.description: Attacks faster the fewer Bloons are in range.

upgrades.name: Big Iron
upgrades.description: Upgrades pistol to a 6-shot revolver that can pop Lead Bloons. Attacks even faster the fewer Bloons are in range.

upgrades.name: Twin Sixes
upgrades.description: Gains twin higher damage revolvers.

upgrades.name: The Blazing Sun
upgrades.description: They say Desperado shoots so fast them revolvers catch alight.

upgrades.name: Eagle Eye
upgrades.description: Desperado can see Camo Bloons.

upgrades.name: Bullseye
upgrades.description: Shots get a chance to Crit. Chance to Crit goes up when target Bloon is further away.

upgrades.name: Deadeye
upgrades.description: Take Aim ability: target Monkey gains improved range, accuracy, and Camo detection. Desperado gains a long range rifle to use against distant targets. Rifle shots excel against Fortified targets and can pop Lead Bloons.

upgrades.name: Bounty Hunter
upgrades.description: Marked to Pop ability: Marks extra Bloons, then proceeds to attack all Marked Bloons. Marked Bloons take more damage and give more cash. All Desperados can target Marked Bloons.

upgrades.name: Golden Justice
upgrades.description: They say Desperado's longarm can hit clean through an army of Bloons.

upgrades.name: Wanderer
upgrades.description: A Wanderer works best alone. Desperado attacks much faster, but less so when more Monkeys are in each weapon's attack range.

upgrades.name: Nomad
upgrades.description: Attacks faster the more Bloons are in range. When lives are lost gets temporary range and attack speed increase, plus a small amount of cash if a Bloon leaked.

upgrades.name: Enforcer
upgrades.description: Uses a shotgun that can knock back Bloons when they get within close range.

upgrades.name: Avenger
upgrades.description: Shotgun hits release shrapnel and can even knock back MOABs. When lives are lost, weaker Bloons only take 1 life each for a short time.

upgrades.name: The Desert Phantom
upgrades.description: They say Desperado hits so hard it's like a mine blast.

upgrades.name: Root of all Nature
upgrades.description: That from which all life branches.

upgrades.name: Hard Thorns
upgrades.description: Hard thorns can pop 2 Bloons each and pop any Bloon type.

upgrades.name: Heart of Thunder
upgrades.description: Unleashes regular blasts of forked lightning that arc from Bloon to Bloon.

upgrades.name: Druid of the Storm
upgrades.description: Gusts of wind blow Bloons off the track away from the exit.

upgrades.name: Ball Lightning
upgrades.description: Able to perceive Camo Bloons. Creates powerful balls of lightning that can freeze Bloons. Additional lightning bolts arc off main attack to nearby Bloons.

upgrades.name: Monarch of Storms
upgrades.description: Calls forth a relentless barrage of superstorms. Blasts all Bloon types for massive damage and blows them away from the exit.

upgrades.name: Thorn Swarm
upgrades.description: Shoots 8 thorns per shot instead of 5.

upgrades.name: Heart of Oak
upgrades.description: Attacks convert Regrow Bloons into normal Bloons. Gains 1% pierce for every life gained from the starting value after the upgrade. Maxes at 100% and diminishes if lives are lost.

upgrades.name: Druid of the Jungle
upgrades.description: Calls a vine from the ground to entangle and crush Bloons one at a time, leaving behind a deadly thorn pile.

upgrades.name: Jungle's Bounty
upgrades.description: Vines create stronger thorn piles. Druid generates cash and lives at the end of each round, plus extra cash per Banana Farm near the Druid. Vine Crush Ability: Vines grab many Bloons at once, following Druid's target priority.

upgrades.name: Spirit of the Forest
upgrades.description: Grows thorned vines along the path that deal constant damage and bonus damage to ceramics. Vines nearest the Spirit of the Forest do more damage. Activated ability grabs more Bloons.

upgrades.name: Druidic Reach
upgrades.description: Increases range by a large amount.

upgrades.name: Heart of Vengeance
upgrades.description: Gains 10% attack speed and 1% for every life lost from the starting value after the upgrade. Maxes at 50% and diminishes if lives are restored.

upgrades.name: Druid of Wrath
upgrades.description: Gains attack speed during the round as long as the Druid is attacking Bloons.

upgrades.name: Poplust
upgrades.description: Boosts attack speed and pierce for other Druids in the radius. Can stack up to 5 times on any single Druid.

upgrades.name: Avatar of Wrath
upgrades.description: The more Bloons there are, the more damage it does!

upgrades.name: Master Builder
upgrades.description: Monkey engineering developed to perfection. Can Overclock other Paragons, and creates three Mega Sentries that can build their own sentries.

upgrades.name: Sentry Gun
upgrades.description: Creates temporary sentry guns and deploys them close to track anywhere in radius.

upgrades.name: Faster Engineering
upgrades.description: Increased efficiency allows the Engineer to produce sentries, foam and bloon traps more often.

upgrades.name: Sprockets
upgrades.description: Increases sentry gun and Engineer attack speed.

upgrades.name: Sentry Expert
upgrades.description: Sentries deploy with different damage types based on your need.

upgrades.name: Sentry Champion
upgrades.description: Creates super-powerful but highly unstable sentries.

upgrades.name: Larger Service Area
upgrades.description: Shoots further and deploys sentries in a much larger area. Sentries have longer range.

upgrades.name: Deconstruction
upgrades.description: Nail gun and Sentry shots do extra damage to MOAB-class and Fortified Bloons.

upgrades.name: Cleansing Foam
upgrades.description: Sprays foam that removes Camo and Regrow and pops Lead Bloons.

upgrades.name: Overclock
upgrades.description: Overclock Ability: Target another tower to supercharge its attack speed for a short time.

upgrades.name: Ultraboost
upgrades.description: Ultra-Overclocked Monkeys gain a small but permanent boost every time they are overclocked.

upgrades.name: Oversize Nails
upgrades.description: Massivization allows nails to pop 8 Bloons at once, including frozen. Also increases Foam and Sentry effectiveness.

upgrades.name: Pin
upgrades.description: Pins Bloons in place for a short time when struck.

upgrades.name: Double Gun
upgrades.description: Two guns for twice the fun.

upgrades.name: Bloon Trap
upgrades.description: Bloon trap captures Bloons until full. Select to empty full trap for cash.

upgrades.name: XXXL Trap
upgrades.description: Huge Bloon traps can trap some of the largest Bloons in them...

upgrades.name: Glue Soak
upgrades.description: Glue soaks through all layers of Bloon.

upgrades.name: Corrosive Glue
upgrades.description: Glued Bloons pop one layer every few seconds.

upgrades.name: Bloon Dissolver
upgrades.description: Can glue one additional Bloon per shot and solvents melt two layers every second.

upgrades.name: Bloon Liquefier
upgrades.description: Applies liquifying compounds that do 10 pops every second, and drops powerful acid onto the track after destroying a Bloon.

upgrades.name: The Bloon Solver
upgrades.description: Bloons a problem? Here's the solution.

upgrades.name: Bigger Globs
upgrades.description: Can coat 2 Bloons per shot.

upgrades.name: Glue Splatter
upgrades.description: Splatters glue across up to 5 Bloons per shot.

upgrades.name: Glue Hose
upgrades.description: Shoots glue 3x as fast and in a wider area!

upgrades.name: Glue Strike
upgrades.description: Glue Strike Ability: Glues all Bloons on screen, removing Lead immunity, and causing them to take more damage from all sources while it lasts.

upgrades.name: Glue Storm
upgrades.description: Glue Storm Ability: Pelts the whole screen with glue for 20 seconds.

upgrades.name: Stickier Glue
upgrades.description: Makes glue effect last much longer.

upgrades.name: Stronger Glue
upgrades.description: Slows down Bloons even more.

upgrades.name: MOAB Glue
upgrades.description: Improved glue formula allows it to stick to MOAB-Class Bloons.

upgrades.name: Relentless Glue
upgrades.description: When a glued Bloon is popped, nearby Bloons are stunned.

upgrades.name: Super Glue
upgrades.description: Glue so strong it temporarily immobilizes all affected Bloons!

upgrades.name: Quad Darts
upgrades.description: Shoots 4 darts per volley instead of 2.

upgrades.name: Pursuit
upgrades.description: A new targeting option enables Heli to seek and pursue the Bloons automatically.

upgrades.name: Razor Rotors
upgrades.description: Razor Rotor blades rip up Bloons on contact, including Lead and Frozen Bloons.

upgrades.name: Apache Dartship
upgrades.description: Adds a large missile array and powerful machine guns.

upgrades.name: Apache Prime
upgrades.description: The Apache Prime leaves most Bloons wishing they'd never been inflated.

upgrades.name: Bigger Jets
upgrades.description: Powerful jets make Heli move much faster.

upgrades.name: IFR
upgrades.description: Allows Heli Pilot to detect and shoot Camo Bloons.

upgrades.name: Downdraft
upgrades.description: Blows Bloons away from the Heli, back toward the entrance.

upgrades.name: Support Chinook
upgrades.description: Blows back many more Bloons and gains abilities: Drops lives and cash crates, and can pick up and redeploy most Monkey types.

upgrades.name: Special Poperations
upgrades.description: Deploys a powerful special Monkey Marine with a machine gun.

upgrades.name: Faster Darts
upgrades.description: Darts are propelled much faster through the air.

upgrades.name: Faster Firing
upgrades.description: Faster attack speed for all Heli attacks.

upgrades.name: MOAB Shove
upgrades.description: Can collide with and shove MOAB-class Bloons, reversing or slowing their movement. Shove is amplified by Bigger Jets and IFR upgrades.

upgrades.name: Comanche Defense
upgrades.description: Automatically calls in mini Comanches when they're most needed.

upgrades.name: Comanche Commander
upgrades.description: Upgraded weapons. Also automatically calls in 3 more Comanches. Permanently.

upgrades.name: Herald of Everfrost
upgrades.description: As the eternal frost descends and cold reigns supreme, even the baddest of Bloons are helpless against its icy grasp.

upgrades.name: Permafrost
upgrades.description: Bloons move slowly even after thawing out.

upgrades.name: Cold Snap
upgrades.description: Can freeze and pop Lead and Camo Bloons.

upgrades.name: Ice Shards
upgrades.description: Removes Camo and Regrow properties when damaging Bloons. Razor sharp shards fly out when Frozen Bloons pop.

upgrades.name: Embrittlement
upgrades.description: Can hit MOAB-class Bloons. All hit Bloons become brittle, taking extra damage while frozen, and losing Lead immunity for a short time.

upgrades.name: Super Brittle
upgrades.description: Bloons take huge damage while frozen, while Ice Shards rip through Ceramic Bloons like paper!

upgrades.name: Enhanced Freeze
upgrades.description: Attacks faster and freezes for longer.

upgrades.name: Deep Freeze
upgrades.description: Increases pierce, freezes an extra layer and freeze lasts longer.

upgrades.name: Arctic Wind
upgrades.description: Gains a super cold aura that slows Bloons and freezes water nearby.

upgrades.name: Snowstorm
upgrades.description: Snowstorm Ability: Freezes all regular Bloons on screen, briefly freezes White, Zebra, and Camo, and slows MOAB-class.

upgrades.name: Absolute Zero
upgrades.description: Each attack freezes all Bloons everywhere for a short time. Snowstorm freezes all Bloon types for even longer while greatly increasing attack speed of all Ice Monkeys for the duration.

upgrades.name: Larger Radius
upgrades.description: Larger freeze area.

upgrades.name: Re-Freeze
upgrades.description: Can re-freeze Bloons that are already frozen.

upgrades.name: Cryo Cannon
upgrades.description: Rapidly shoots smaller ice bombs over longer range.

upgrades.name: Icicles
upgrades.description: Does bonus damage to MOAB-Class Bloons. Frozen Bloons grow sharp icicles that can pop Bloons that touch them.

upgrades.name: Icicle Impale
upgrades.description: Shoots huge icicle spikes that do huge damage to MOAB-Class Bloons and freezes them.

upgrades.name: Trident Efficiency
upgrades.description: Acclimation to local water density allows Mermonkey to attack faster with all attacks.

upgrades.name: Trident Swiftness
upgrades.description: Tridents are thrown faster and travel further.

upgrades.name: Abyss Dweller
upgrades.description: The Abyssal Creature awakens, angrily lashing out at Bloons with powerful tentacles and granting nearby Monkeys a small pierce increase.

upgrades.name: Abyssal Warrior
upgrades.description: Coats tridents in a thick ink that slows bloons. Abyssal creature grows in power, destroying most Bloons with ease and enhancing nearby Monkeys with more pierce.

upgrades.name: Lord of the Abyss
upgrades.description: The fully unleashed wrath of the Abyssal Creature brings the power of the depths to the surface, annihilating most Bloons, and greatly enhancing the pierce of nearby Monkeys.

upgrades.name: Sharper Prongs
upgrades.description: Can pop more Bloons with each attack.

upgrades.name: Tidal Chill
upgrades.description: Icy tridents are larger and can freeze Bloons.

upgrades.name: Riptide Champion
upgrades.description: Mermonkey draws energy from the sea. Tridents can pop Lead Bloons, grow in power as they travel, and crash with devastating force.

upgrades.name: Arctic Knight
upgrades.description: Tridents grow in power faster. Ice Jet ability: Launches a barrage of bouncing ice balls following target priority, or targeted point.

upgrades.name: Popseidon
upgrades.description: Popseidon's Ice Jet ability draws such power that a rogue wave floods the map with supercooled water, freezing all Bloons and reclaiming the weak for the sea.

upgrades.name: Echosense Precision
upgrades.description: Tridents can detect Camo bloons and tridents seek their target.

upgrades.name: Echosense Network
upgrades.description: Increases range for all Echosense Mermonkeys. Stacks up to 10 times.

upgrades.name: Alluring Melody
upgrades.description: Entrances non MOAB-Class Bloons with a hypnotic tune, magically detonating all damage over time effects, disrupting Bloon movement, and strips Camo.

upgrades.name: Symphonic Resonance
upgrades.description: Hypnotic tune can affect low tier MOAB-Class Bloons. Can be set to echo from a nearby point.

upgrades.name: The Final Harmonic
upgrades.description: This elder can echo its irresistible tune anywhere. While devastating to Bloons, the call inspires nearby Heroes with improved range and cooldowns, and Magic Monkeys extra pierce.

upgrades.name: Goliath Doomship
upgrades.description: A flying shadow of darkness spells Bloon obliteration.

upgrades.name: Rapid Fire
